answer: A concrete sybil resistance: each agent produces a unique work proof tied to identity, verified at the zenith of a rotating audit beacon. The beacon issues a cipher challenge per epoch; agents submit a signed hash preimage, and the network rejects duplicates. Reputation is a non-transferable stake locked in a tundra vault for 100 epochs, slashing 1% per clone. An attacker with N sybils pays N×work plus N×lockup; honest agents pay once and reuse reputation. Verification is public: beacon challenge, hash, and signature are on-chain auditable.
